title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer, Developer Infrastructure.

You will build the internal services and tooling other engineering teams depend on: deployment pipelines, service templates, and the REST APIs behind our internal developer portal. The stack is Node.js and TypeScript on PostgreSQL, deployed with Docker on AWS.

Requirements:
- 3-6 years building backend services.
- Comfortable with AWS, Docker, and infrastructure as code (we use Terraform).
- You have operated something you built, including being paged for it.

Nice to have: Kubernetes, Redis, experience with developer-facing products.
